query: SELECT p.projectId, p.name, COUNT(ps.id) as site_count FROM projects p LEFT JOIN project_sites ps ON p.projectId = ps.projectId AND ps.isActive = 1 WHERE p.projectId LIKE 'TRANSTEST%' GROUP BY p.projectId, p.name ORDER BY p.projectId;
